_comment: Sentences in the Reality Fracture cheat sheet that are judgement calls about this
set, not facts build_cheat_sheet.py can derive. Anything not listed here is
generated. Delete this file for a new set and the tool writes generic versions.
Kept short on purpose: reader feedback on DEC-925 asked for instructions, not explanations.

pair_plans: one plan sentence + 'look for' cards per pair. Sources: WotC prerelease guide (archetype names, key cards) and Tolarian Community College's prerelease guide (plans); every card checked against grades.json.
title: # Reality Fracture prerelease cheat sheet (DEC-925)
intro: Sealed grades, 0 to 10, from oracle text, checked against Draftsim and Limited Resources. ★ bomb · ✕ removal · ⚡ instant-speed · ◆ fixing · ⚪🔵⚫🔴🟢 colour · 🟡 gold · ◇ colourless. A grade in parentheses applies once your deck holds that many enablers.
procedure_splash: 5. **Splash only a 7+ card, only with 2+ lands that make its colour** (Annex/Commons duals, rare slowlands, Room of Refuge). Landcyclers and Murmuring Volume help but do not count. Max 2 cards.
procedure_tiebreak: 7. **Tie between pairs?** More 6+ cards wins; then synergy counts (Jace, graveyard, lifegain); then more 2-drops.
removal_lead: ⚫ Black and 🔴 red have the most removal cards. ⚪ White has fewer, but its commons and uncommons are the best. 🔵 Blue has almost none.
ranking_commentary: **Tier 1: WB. Tier 2: BR, WG, UB, UR, WU, WR, BG. Tier 3: UG, RG.** Tiers, not an order: the pool you open decides.
ranking_reading: **At the table:** 3+ black or red ✕ opened → WB, WR or BR. White bomb + lifegain → WG. Blue only with its removal (Infinite Coursework, Plan for All Outcomes, a charm) or a bomb. Green is the least likely main colour, not a bad one.

WB.name: Liliana's Attrition
WB.plan: Trade one-for-one, then win on recursion. Discard, sacrifice and removal fill both graveyards; you are the one who gets cards back.
WB.look_for: Rank Rat [3], Gallia, Tragic Host [4], Campus Crier [4], Fateshaper Aspirant [4], Generous Revival [4], Massacre Girl [6], Liliana the Repentant [5].

BR.name: Stingerquill
BR.plan: Cheap creatures early, burn to the face to finish. Noncombat damage (Vicious Verse, burn) turns on the payoffs.
BR.look_for: No Admittance [7], Screeching Soulbreaker [5], Master of Barbs [5], Cast Away Doubt [4], Command the Stage [4], the three Vicious Verse creatures [4].

WG.name: Vigorbloom
WG.plan: Aggressive lifegain: every life gained adds counters or cards. Attack, do not turtle.
WG.look_for: Greenhouse Propagator [5], Enlightened Confidant [6], Lyra, Archangel of Dawn [7], Titanbones [5→7], Koth of the Homestead [5], Unflinching Hortimancer [3→5], Seed Suture creatures.

UB.name: Theorix
UB.plan: Mill yourself to threshold (7 in graveyard), grind with flashback and recursion. Slow; needs both enablers and payoffs.
UB.look_for: Omit Variables creatures (Paradox Shaper [5], Metamage [5], Void Extrapolator [4→5]), Divining Duelist [5], Proft, Sinister Mastermind [4→7], Yuriko, Hope from the Shadows [4], Dark Matter Manipulator [3→6].

UR.name: Chandra's Prowess
UR.plan: Noncreature spells grow prowess bodies and make thopters. Build it aggro (burn) or control (bounce, draw); either way keep 12+ creatures.
UR.look_for: Plan for All Outcomes [6], Pia, Determined Rebuilder [5], Variable Chaser [5], Chandra's Emberling [4], Tomik, Izzet Sparkmage [4], Pyre Rhymer [4].

WU.name: Fatehold
WU.plan: Surveil triggers grow the team or make tokens; play to the board and win in the air. Best home for Jace tokens (repeat surveils).
WU.look_for: Saheeli, Consul of Oversight [7→8], Mindseeker Oculus [6], Hexhaven Battalion [6], Semester Foreseer [5], Surveillance Phantasm [4→6], Peer Review creatures.

WR.name: Ajani's Army
WR.plan: Go wide and fast: tokens, +1/+1 counters, tricks that punish blocks. Keep 16+ creatures; spells are removal and tricks only.
WR.look_for: Guiding Hydra [7], Hexhaven Battalion [6], Heartstring Puller [5], Skilled Battlecarver [4], Graft Surgeon [4], Gallia, the Merrymaker [4], Charge the Sanctum [3].

BG.name: Garruk's Bestiary
BG.plan: Big tramplers plus deathtouch grants plus the best removal. Low synergy; pick card quality.
BG.look_for: Bestial Incursion [6], Ruric Thar, Magecrusher [7], Ferocity of the Hunt [4], Teyo, Diamondblade Mage [4], Rampart Hunter [3], Rewrite Regrets [4].

UG.name: Jace's Mastery
UG.plan: Empower Jace, protect the token, play long. Defensive creatures, removal and counters; the Way enchantments are your planeswalkers.
UG.look_for: Plan for All Outcomes [6], Arcane Amphisbaena [5], Proft, Consulting Detective [5→7], Inspired Tethermage [4→5], Countersculpt [4], Tam's Resistance [4], any Way of the… [4-6].

RG.name: Konstrari
RG.plan: Heartwood tokens ramp into big creatures. Balance ramp with early blockers and removal or you get run over.
RG.look_for: Kiora of Fire and Ashes [7], Hungering Puppetbeast [7], Draconic Visitor [8], Craterclaw Colossus [7→8], Greenhouse Propagator [5], Heartwood Crafter [4], Wrecking Gecko [4].
